title: Wulite, nwalee ma chekwaa dashboard onye nwe nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi

say: Wulite, nwalee ma chekwaa dashboard onye nwe nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul abụọ nke Advanced Excel na Dashboards.
A na-enye ọtụtụ dashboard nri site na mbupụ sitere na sistemụ POS, ụlọ akụ ma ọ bụ ngwa ngụkọ ego. Iji aka na-ehicha ha kwa ọnwa anaghị adị ngwa, ọ bụkwa ebe njehie na-abata.

say: Mepụta mpaghara nlele. Nlele nlele ọ bụla na-atụnyere ọnụọgụ abụọ ga-ekwenyerịrị, ihe dị iche kwesịrị ịbụ 0.
Tebụlụ isi mmalite Ada gbakwunyere naịra 18,912,500, mana dashboard gosiri 18,600,000.

Oghere ahụ bụ 312,500. Pivot rụtụrụ aka n'usoro a kapịrị ọnụ, ya mere, a hapụghị akwụkwọ ọnụahịa 5 n'oge nke 62,500 nke ọ bụla. Ọ na-atụ aka na tblSales, na-enye ume ọhụrụ, na nlele ahụ na-alaghachi 0.
Tinye nkwado data na sel ntinye, kpọghee naanị sel ndị ahụ, wee chekwaa mpempe akwụkwọ ahụ. Nwalee na slicers ka na-arụ ọrụ. Mana nchedo mpempe akwụkwọ na-egbochi naanị ihe mberede.

panel.heading: Nchedo abụghị nchekwa
right: Maka ụgwọ ọnwa, ndị ahịa, nkọwa ụlọ akụ

say: Maka ụgwọ ọnwa, nkọwa ndị ahịa ma ọ bụ ozi ụlọ akụ, jiri Encrypt na Paswọdu, jiri okwuntughe siri ike ezigara site na ọwa dị iche.
Mbupụ na-ejidekarị aha ndị ahịa na nọmba ekwentị. Wepu ogidi ndị ị na-achọghị, na ebupụkwala mbupụ raw na WhatsApp nkeonwe.

panel.heading: Nchedo abụghị nchekwa
right: Maka ụgwọ ọnwa, ndị ahịa, nkọwa ụlọ akụ

say: Tupu izipu faịlụ, tinye akara n'ihe ọ bụla. Jiri data na-adịghị mma nwalee na ebumnuche: ọnụ ọgụgụ oghere, ụbọchị pịnyere dị ka ederede, akwụkwọ ọnụahịa oyiri.
Ejila IFERROR na efu zoo njehie, n'ihi na nleba anya agbajiri ga-adị ka ezigbo efu.
N'ikpeazụ, dee akwụkwọ ka o si arụ ọrụ ma rịọ onye ọzọ ka o soro ya na-enweghị enyemaka gị.

say: Megharịa mbubata site na folda opekata mpe faịlụ atọ. Jiri kaadị, chaatị dị iche iche na slicer ejikọrọ wuo dashboard otu ihuenyo gị. Mgbe ahụ tinye sel nlele, chebe ya wee dee mpempe akwụkwọ ka ọ si arụ ọrụ.
Ugbu a gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
